name: LLM-GeoDis
description: LLM-GeoDis is a global database of subnationally geocoded disaster events extracted from the EM-DAT International Disaster Database using large language models. It provides standardized location descriptions linked to administrative units with detailed geospatial data for over 14,000 disaster events.
reputation: A niche but useful geospatial disaster-information extraction resource derived from EM-DAT, mainly of interest to researchers working on disaster data curation and geocoding.
notes: Dataset and code repository for geoparsing and geocoding disaster events; large scale (~30 GB) with multiple data files and external dependencies.
